Recorded claim:
smimeGenCSR gathers file, algorithm and strength through standard prompt dialogs, then confirms a summary before calling nsICertGen.gen. Cancel at any earlier prompt returns. The Back choice in the summary restarts at step 1 because the standard selection dialogs have no back button. The reviewer questioned the label but accepted the author’s scoped choice. This sequence matters because key generation creates a permanent key; preserve the no-generation-on-cancel behavior when changing the prompts.
